Liber VI · Moyses is a PROBĀTIŌ liber (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_l6)
and it is THE TRACK'S FIRST TRĀNSITUS. Two phases: trānsitus hp 3 / 45 s
(the Red Sea corridor, wall: 'murusAquae' — the very actor h33's pages
are drawn with) then sententia hp 3 / 50 s. The trānsitus phase draws its
words from the liber's own vocabulary automatically (env.words = 27
carded lexemes across eight capitula), so it ships no item list.
Legacy single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 6 / 55 s, kept for
the same reason l2-l5 keep theirs: a client without js/probatio.js must
still run something, and rule_boss_min_ms('l6') is derived from it.
*** bossMinMs 20000, NOT 15000 — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING. Every
previous Historia trial got l3's 15 s floor because a SENTENTIA is
floored by the child's reading speed and not by a machine. The TRĀNSITUS
phase is different and is floored the way l2's ORDINA is: js/probatio.js
spawns at most 3 words at a time on a 0.8-1.3 s timer, the corridor
narrows on a clock (this.narrow, ~3.4-4.6 px/s), and hp 3 means THREE
correct catches have to physically fall down the screen before the phase
can end. That pump cannot be outrun, so a 15 s whole-trial floor would be
below what an honest player can achieve and would stop flagging anything.
20 s is l2's number for l2's reason. If the integrator prefers to keep
the track uniform at 15000, that is a defensible call — but it should be
a decision and not an oversight, which is why it is written down. ***
EIGHT capitula, five quiz questions — the largest liber in the track so
far. h33 is the trānsitus phase itself and h34 and h36 are in the
sententia phase, so every one of the eight capitula is represented
exactly once somewhere in the trial. The five quiz pictures come from
five different families — a basket on the Nile, a burning bush, a locust,
two stone tablets, a walled city — so no two can be confused at 96 px.
quizKey carries the same {q, a} pair per row that r03-r07, l3, l4 and l5
use: rules.php stores the question word and the vocab key that must be
picked, so grading never depends on the order the client drew the options
in. For a word -> pick-the-image quiz the answer IS the question word,
and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in
content/historia-l6.js.
l6 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
